items.label: Profit Target
items.detail: $50K→$3,000 · $100K→$6,000 · $150K→$9,000. No minimum trading days required.

items.label: Daily Loss Limit
items.detail: $50K→$1,250 · $100K→$2,500 · $150K→$3,750. Breaching = immediate account closure.

items.label: Max Drawdown
items.detail: $50K→$2,500 · $100K→$3,500 · $150K→$5,000. Trails end-of-day balance. Locks at starting balance once profit threshold is reached, then adds $100 buffer (e.g. $50K locks at $50,100).

items.label: Consistency Rule
items.detail: Applies in both eval and funded. No single day's profit may equal or exceed 40% of total profits. Must keep trading until ratio drops below 40%. Does not breach account — only blocks passing/payout.

items.label: Position Scaling
items.detail: May scale into winning positions. Avoid large upfront contract sizes as a gambling strategy.

items.label: Evaluation Reset
items.detail: Available within 7 days of failing evaluation. Reset restarts from beginning.

items.label: Trading Hours
items.detail: All open trades auto-close at 16:10 EST. Not a breach.

items.label: News Trading
items.detail: No open/close/pending orders within 5 min before or after any Red Folder release (FOMC, CPI, NFP, Powell, JOLTS, PMI, PPI etc.). 2-min buffer for all news events. News trading alone cannot be the sole method to pass evaluation.

items.label: Overnight Hold
items.detail: No restriction on holding positions overnight.

items.label: Weekend Hold
items.detail: No restriction on weekend positions.

items.label: Martingale
items.detail: Permitted within margin and contract limits. Inconsistent sizing to recover losses may trigger review.

items.label: Max R:R Ratio
items.detail: Stop loss must not exceed 5× profit target. Example: $100 target → max $500 stop loss.

items.label: 2% Price Limit
items.detail: No trading within 2% of CME daily price limits. Monitor % Net Change on quote board.

items.label: Inactivity
items.detail: Funded stage: at least one trade per 7-day period. Contact support before extended breaks.

items.label: Prohibited
items.detail: Microscalping (<few seconds, >200 trades/day), AI/full automation, collaborative/coordinated trading, account sharing, delayed data exploitation, simulated fill gaming, CME rule violations.

items.label: Profit Split
items.detail: First $15,000 of total profits = 100%. All profits beyond $15,000 = 90% split.

items.label: Payout Cycle
items.detail: Every 7 days. Requires 5 profitable winning days per cycle.

items.label: Winning Day Min.
items.detail: Minimum net profit per winning day: $100 ($50K) · $200 ($100K) · $300 ($150K).

items.label: Consistency
items.detail: Best single day must not exceed 40% of total payout-period profits.

items.label: Payout Minimum
items.detail: Minimum payout request across all account sizes.

items.label: First Payout DD
items.detail: After first payout, max drawdown adjusts to starting balance + $100. Maintain buffer before requesting.

items.label: Processing
items.detail: Processed Mon–Fri before 3PM CST via Riseworks. If delayed past 24 hrs → $200 bonus automatically added.

items.label: Max Funded Accounts
items.detail: Up to 3 funded accounts (live or simulated) at any time. Funded accounts cannot be reset.

items.label: Live Account
items.detail: Risk team monitors sim funded performance. Consistent traders receive live account invitation. Live accounts have static drawdown, customizable daily loss limit, and scaling.
